title: Add missing .dockerignore for dashboard build context
description:
**Bug**: The `dashboard/` directory has no `.dockerignore` file. Since `docker-compose.yml` sets `context: ./dashboard`, the entire `node_modules/` (195MB+) and `dist/` are sent as build context, causing build failures with "invalid file request node_modules/.bin/..." errors.

Additionally, the root `.dockerignore` did not exclude `dashboard/node_modules` for Go service builds that use `.` as context, causing the same failures.

**Fix applied during E2E**: Created `dashboard/.dockerignore` with `node_modules`, `dist`, `.git`, `*.swp`, `*.tmp`, `*.log`, `*.zip`. Updated root `.dockerignore` to add `**/node_modules`, `dashboard/node_modules`, `dashboard/dist`, `dashboard/src.zip`, `.moe`, `*.exe`, `*.png`, `*.zip`.

**Files**: `dashboard/.dockerignore` (new), `.dockerignore` (updated)
definitionOfDone: dashboard/.dockerignore exists with node_modules and dist excluded
Root .dockerignore excludes dashboard/node_modules for Go service builds
docker compose build succeeds without node_modules context errors

implementationPlan.description: Verify existing dockerignore files already satisfy all DoD items. Both files already exist with correct content from E2E work. No code changes needed.
